payload.test_method: Functional and hostile-path tests, exhaustive simulated workspace layouts, offscreen guide scenarios, QML lint, plugin validation, live guide summon, binding inspection, and visual inspection were recorded. Only one monitor was connected.
payload.expected_result: The optional number-pad actions and guide operate without breaking the existing shortcut workflow, including on multi-monitor layouts.
payload.actual_result: Automated tests, live binding checks, guide summon, and visual inspection passed. The guide opened and the plugin retained its existing shortcut behavior.
payload.limitations: Physical multi-monitor behavior was unavailable and remains unverified. The large simulated layout set is not hardware confirmation. Protection resets when its window closes or when the compositor restarts or reloads.
payload.provenance: Imported from the private journal with the exact public plugin revision linked; no private desktop state or screenshots are attached.
payload.adverse_effects: No adverse effect was recorded in the tested single-monitor session. The plugin runs unsandboxed, changes compositor bindings, and may create an optional launcher entry only after confirmation.

activation.details: The plugin service and guide panel were active after an Omarchy Shell restart.

root_cause.rationale: This is an optional workflow extension rather than a diagnosed defect.
